title: Financial Assistance Policy — Denial of a Patient Hardship Discount Program Application and Appeal
content:
## Clause 1. Permitted reasons for denial

1.1 An application to the Patient Hardship Discount Program is denied only for one of these four reasons:

(a) **Income above the limit** — the household's percentage of the poverty guideline is above every band the applicant could qualify for;

(b) **Documents not received** — the required documents have not arrived by the documents due date on file, after any extension;

(c) **Incomplete application** — the household or income questions are left unanswered;

(d) **Medicaid eligible, not applied** — the level requires a Medicaid screening, the screening shows likely Medicaid eligibility, and the applicant has not applied for Medicaid within the level's deadline, in calendar days, after the screening.

1.2 A denial records the denial reason, the determination date and the date the case closed, and the case status becomes *denied*.

## Clause 2. Who denies

2.1 A denial is made by the business office, never on the applicant's request.

## Clause 3. Appeal

3.1 A denial may be appealed in writing within the level's appeal window, which is 30 calendar days after the determination date at every level.

3.2 While an appeal is open, the collections hold continues.

## Schedule A. Reason (d) by its three conditions

| Level requires a Medicaid screening | Screening shows likely Medicaid eligibility | Applicant has not applied within the deadline after the screening | Reason (d) available |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No (applied in time) | No |
| Yes | No | — | No |
| No | — | — | No |

## Schedule B. Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- **Reason (b).** The documents due date on file, after one extension, is 2026-05-20. Documents received on 2026-05-20 arrived by the due date, so reason (b) is not available. If on 2026-05-20 required documents have still not arrived, reason (b) is available.
- **Appeal.** A denial carries a determination date of 2026-06-01. A written appeal received on 2026-06-15, fourteen calendar days later, is within the 30-day appeal window. While that appeal is open the collections hold continues.
- **Applicant's request.** An applicant asks for the application to be denied. Clause 2.1 does not permit a denial on that ground.
